title: Robot Arm
card: A robot arm drops a block in the bin you pick. Move the bin while it carries the block: its real-time brain follows.
tagline: Move the bin while the arm carries the block, and the arm follows
kicker: ADAPTS IN REAL TIME WHEN THE TARGET MOVES
feature: The arm's brain runs in real time, like a living brain: it senses and settles about five times a second. Move the bin while the arm carries the block, and its next moves head for the new place, which it never saw in training.
howTo: Drag the block or a bin, pick Bin A or Bin B (its lamp lights) and press Run. Once the arm holds the block, drag the lit bin to a new place and watch the arm follow it. Point at a ? to see what a part does.
